name: JSTI Group
summary: JSTI Group, together with its subsidiaries, provides infrastructure solutions in China and internationally. The company offers engineering consulting services, including planning consulting, surveying and design, environmental services, comprehensive testing, and project management; and engineering contracting services, such as design, procurement, construction, and commissioning services. It serves highways, municipal affairs, railways, urban rail transit, water transportation and conservancy, environment, architecture, aviation, and electric power industries.
